inputs.name: event
inputs.description: Primary input object for the Telemetry Agent.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Optional contextual data (identity, environment, linked resources).

outputs.name: actions
outputs.description: Structured output describing what the Telemetry Agent decided or performed.

outputs.name: logs
outputs.description: Human-readable log lines explaining key decisions.

error_handling.on_invalid_input: Return a validation error with an explanation; do not attempt to proceed.
error_handling.on_missing_context: Proceed conservatively, explicitly stating assumptions and limitations.
